description: Which countries, US states and Canadian provinces have pay transparency rules here (salary range in job ads, salary history ban, pay information requests, gender pay gap): jurisdiction codes, rule types, official sources with dates, rule-pack version. Not for: whether an EU country has transposed the Directive (eu_transposition_status), minimum wage or tax.
